operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: retain the exact source and private settings, pause writes and scheduled work, export the installation, restore into an empty destination, run owner setup and re-export to compare fingerprints before routing traffic. Preserve applied migration names and bytes.
